title: 斜照
standfirst: 石拱、朱檐与城楼接住亮处；山线退后，海边的人渐渐只剩轮廓。
standfirstEn: An arch, eaves and a castle receive the light. Ridges recede; people by the water become outlines.
introduction: 石拱内外留着同一片暖云，山影则把金色水面与深云分开。光没有平均地照亮眼前的东西：朱檐上的一段木构，高楼前的城楼，或远山之间几处很小的水面，各自接住一部分。
七幅照片沿着亮处经过的表面展开，再让云的间隙与海边的人影进入。地点各不相同，照片之间保留的是明暗如何落到一个形状上。
introductionEn: Warm clouds lie within and beyond an arch, while hills separate golden water from dark cloud. Light reaches things unevenly: a timber beneath an eave, a castle before towers, or small stretches of water between distant ridges.

Seven photographs follow the surfaces receiving that light, then move towards openings in cloud and silhouettes by the water. The places differ; the sequence retains how brightness and shade meet a form.

chapters.title: 受光面
chapters.text: 木构的近处细节与城楼的远处轮廓，被同一种偏暖的光照见。阴影留在旁边，继续给出厚度与距离。
chapters.textEn: Warm light reveals nearby timbers and the outline of a farther castle. Shadows remain beside them, giving depth and distance.

chapters.title: 云间
chapters.text: 山线退到金色后面，浅亮水面分成细小几段。转到另一片云下，光束只从间隙里穿过，仍有大片地方暗着。
chapters.textEn: Ridges recede behind gold, with bright water divided into small stretches. Elsewhere, shafts of light enter through gaps beneath cloud, leaving broad areas dark.

chapters.title: 近水
chapters.text: 亮处收回天际，近处的人与犬只剩轮廓。水面的细波仍然可见，经过的身体从它前面横过。
chapters.textEn: Brightness withdraws to the horizon as people and a dog become outlines. Fine ripples remain visible behind the passing bodies.
